title: CAVEAT rebuttal source manifest row
description: One line of mappings/rebuttals/manifest.jsonl: a source cited by one or more caveat:RebuttalLink nodes. See docs/rebuttals.md.

id.description: Stable key; the link node local name is rebuttal_{Mode}_{id}.

source.description: The caveat:rebuttalSource IRI: https://doi.org/{doi} when doi is set, otherwise the canonical URL.

is_retracted.description: Retraction status of the DOI when retrieved.

archivedAt.description: Archived copy; required when there is no DOI.

venueType.description: Where the source was posted. Recorded, never ranked.
